summary.text: Pepper McFarland is an Undeclared candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 33, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A high school teacher, she is running against Republican incumbent Glenn Prax and Republican Barbara Haney.

paragraphs.text: Pepper McFarland works as a high school teacher.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in District 33 for 16 years, has voted undeclared throughout her voting life, and describes herself as fiscally conservative and socially focused on caring for elders, veterans and children.
She listed her key messages as funding education and attracting and retaining educators, pursuing multiple sources of energy, and reducing the state's reliance on oil prices to fund government.
McFarland said her endorsements include the Alaska State Employees Association/AFSCME Local 52, the Fairbanks Central Labor Council/AFL-CIO and the Alaska Public Employees Association/AFT.
